TC-14/S21.title: The full retry sequence stays within about 30 s
TC-14/S21.detail: Code read on 8b4be94a: convex/ai/providers/retry.ts unchanged since 43c38a4f (CALL_BUDGET_MS 30000, ATTEMPT_TIMEOUT_MS 20000, MIN 8000, RETRY_DELAY 1000, RETRY_PRIMARY_IF_FAILED_WITHIN 10000), so the computed worst case is still about 38 s (Q22 / D8, a decision, not a bug). The note is now generated by the server job (ai/notes.ts run): one chat() call for the note before the follow-ups, so the physician-facing wait follows the same budget; dev notes on this build took 5–9 s.
